text:
Elena: Hey team, I just opened a late-stage PR that updates the migration guide and adds an SDK snippet. Need a reviewer and someone to validate the docs preview before merge. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/987 — target to merge before EOD tomorrow if CI/preview is green.
Tom: I can take a quick pass on the snippet tomorrow morning. Tagging @Priya for preview sanity check since the Netlify preview has been flaky. :+1:
Priya: I can do the preview check. Noted the preview bot sometimes drops images for me. Will re-run the build if it fails.
Jared: Heads up — last time we merged a migration guide during release window it caused a version skew. If this touches the sidebar/nav, let's also sync with release notes. I can coordinate after review.
Elena: It only adds a small "SDK quick start" section under /guides/migration.md and a new file examples/sdk/quickstart.md. No nav edits. Still want the release note link though.
docs-bot: Preview build started: https://deploy-preview-987--docs.redwood-inference.com (status: building)
Tom: Quick note on the snippet: please use the SDK client pattern we standardized — `const client = new RedwoodClient({ apiKey })` — also add the minimal error handling example.
Elena: Good catch. I'll push a small patch in a minute.
Elena: Pushed. Commit: 3a7f2d9 — updated snippet and added a one-line note about runtime config.
docs-bot: CI status: checks/requested -> linkcheck failing on external link to old partner blog (HTTP 410).
Priya: Ugh linkcheck again. I can update the link to the archived copy or remove it. Which do we prefer?
Jared: Prefer archived copy and add a short note "archived". Keeps context.
Elena: I'll swap to the archived URL and mark it. Pushing now.
Elena: Pushed fix for link (commit: 3a7f9ab).
docs-bot: Preview build succeeded: https://deploy-preview-987--docs.redwood-inference.com (status: success)
Priya: I looked through the preview: snippet render looks good, code block formatting is fine, examples folder indexes correctly. I left one tiny nit — s/`apiKey`/`process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY` in the snippet to encourage env usage.
Tom: I'll take final review after that nit is updated. Low-risk otherwise.
Elena: Updated to env var (commit: 3a812ff).
docs-bot: CI status: all checks passed.
Tom: LGTM from me. :shipit:
Jared: Approved for merge once release-note task is created. I added a short TODO in the PR description to remind release team.
Elena: Thanks! I'll merge after the 15-minute wait window and add the release note link.
Priya: If anyone's merging, please squash-merge to keep the example history tidy.
Tom: Agreed.
Elena: Done — merged and added release note link. Closing the loop. :tada:
Jared: Thanks for the quick turnaround.
Priya: Nice work.
Elena: Appreciated — will follow up if anything in prod looks off.
